C0368.title: Cracking User Passwords with Hashcat in HTB Perfection Machine
C0368.summary: During the penetration test of the HTB Perfection machine, after gaining shell access as user susan via SSTI injection, an SQLite database file was discovered in the user's home directory. The password hash was identified as SHA256.
